agent.notes: check.py does NOT pass: head coverage of changed lines is 22/38 (0.579 < 0.8). Everything else is OK (installs fine, base ~6.9 s, no-network OK, base coverage 5/6). The missing head lines are dead code: the lightweight-switch branch only runs if getattr(model, 'is_valid', lambda: False)() is true, and no class in the project defines is_valid. So update_album_root_lightweight and prepare_for_album_lightweight can never run without patching the model. The workload builds a library of 4 sub-albums x 60 generated JPEGs indexed with the project's own rescan (template cached under /tmp/kt_483 and copied fresh each run). It binds LibraryManager and AppFacade (Qt offscreen) and runs root -> each album -> root six times, waiting for loadFinished each time. It records active model, row count and a hash of loaded paths; the last line is a SHA-256 of these. Digests differ as expected: on base sub-albums use the album model (reset and reload), on head they reuse the library model. Row counts and loaded paths are the same on both sides. Sub-albums are pre-indexed so no async rescans start; this avoids an existing deleteLater race in controller.py that made base crash intermittently. Qt thread-pool loader workers do real work.
